fields.System.Title: OUT-602 — Scan cartons onto a shipment
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk, I want to scan each carton as it is loaded, so that the manifest
reflects what is physically on the vehicle.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a packed and labelled carton, when I scan it onto the shipment, then it is
  • added.
  • - Given an unpacked or unlabelled carton, then the scan is rejected.
  • - Given a carton already on another shipment, then the scan is rejected — enforced by a
  • unique constraint on carton-to-shipment.
  • - Given a carton whose order specifies a different carrier, then a warning is shown
  • before it is accepted.
  • - Given a shipped shipment, then no further cartons can be added.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | shipment, shipment_carton, carton |
| Risks | Carton onto the wrong vehicle or onto two shipments ([doc 05 WF 8](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency |
